officialProductListing.evidence: The listing identifies RX as a directional carving-oriented board and describes a 26/27 Hard Flex option.
officialProductListing.limitations: Retail listing is not an independent ride test; its current variant is not represented by a disclosed on-snow sample.

officialDemoList2025-26.location: White World Oze Iwakura, Gunma, Japan
officialDemoList2025-26.evidence: Manufacturer-hosted 25/26 demo-board list confirms regular RX and RX Ti were available in multiple sizes for the event.
officialDemoList2025-26.limitations: Inventory list only; no rider report or outcomes. Adjacent season, not the seed's 26/27 product.

historicalRetailOverview2021-22.evidence: 2021-22 model overview describes RX as a longer carving-oriented progression from R-2, with taper, sidecut and camber intended for strong grip and deep turns; lists sizes 154N/159N/159/164/169/174.
historicalRetailOverview2021-22.limitations: Promotional/model overview, not a disclosed test; five model years older than the seed. Do not use for current-season specifications or scores.

reviewSearch.result: Search located a historical carving demonstration video and older owner/forum pages, but no sufficiently disclosed independent 26/27 (or adjacent-season) RX test covering sample size, conditions, and ride observations.

scoringEvidence.decision: Retain all six 26/27 scores only as low-confidence product-positioning estimates. Carving-oriented retail copy and a 25/26 demo inventory list do not establish measured stability/response, and the older 21/22 shop overview is several seasons out of date and not a test. Float, park and forgiveness have no sufficiently direct current evidence. Value is converted Japan pricing, not a Chinese-market quote. No outside score is mapped to site dimensions.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low across all dimensions, especially float/park/forgiveness/value; 26/27 hard-flex variant further limits inference from older regular models.
